charts.title: Revenue of the health and fitness market in Europe from 2017 to 2022 (in billion euros)
charts.short: Value of the European health and fitness industry 2017-2022
charts.description: The health and fitness market in Europe was worth an estimated 28 billion U.S. dollars in 2022. This is a significant increase in the market size of just over 17 billion U.S. dollars in 2021. This can be attributed to the continued recovery of the industry following the impact of the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic, which forced the temporary closure of thousands of gyms and health clubs across Europe.

charts.title: Revenue of the fitness industry in Europe in 2022, by country (in billion euros)
charts.short: Revenue of leading fitness markets in Europe 2022
charts.description: In 2022, the revenue of the fitness industry in Germany stood at 4.9 billion euros. Meanwhile, the health and fitness market in the United Kingdom was estimated to be worth five billion euros.

charts.title: Revenue of the gym industry in France from 2015 to 2022 (in million euros)
charts.short: Fitness club revenue in France 2015-2022
charts.description: The revenue of the gym industry in France more than doubled between 2015 and 2022. Latest estimates showed that the fitness club market in France was worth around 238 million euros in 2022.

charts.title: Number of gyms and health clubs in Europe from 2009 to 2022
charts.short: Number of health and fitness clubs in Europe 2009-2022
charts.description: The number of gyms and health clubs in Europe has generally been on the increase since 2009. While there was a slight dip in the number of establishments in 2020 as a result of the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic, the number of gyms in Europe increased again in 2022, reaching 63,830.

charts.title: Number of members at health and fitness clubs in Europe in 2022, by country (in millions)
charts.short: Gym membership in European countries 2022
charts.description: In 2022, there were approximately 10.4 million gym members in the United Kingdom. Meanwhile, there were around 5.4 million members at health clubs and fitness establishments in Spain.

charts.title: Revenue of the gym industry in France from 2015 to 2022 (in million euros)
charts.short: Fitness club revenue in France 2015-2022
charts.description: The revenue of the gym industry in France more than doubled between 2015 and 2022. Latest estimates showed that the fitness club market in France was worth around 238 million euros in 2022.

charts.title: Number of gyms in selected cities in France as of May 2023
charts.short: Gyms in France 2023
charts.description: There were over 5.4 thousand gyms across France in 2023. The city with the most number of fitness centers in the country was Marseille. Meanwhile, there were over 250 gyms in France's capital city, Paris.

charts.title: Number of Basic-Fit gyms in 2023, by country
charts.short: Number of clubs of Basic-Fit 2023, by country
charts.description: As of the end of 2023, there were over 220 Basic-Fit gyms in Belgium. France was the biggest market for the Dutch fitness company, with the country home to 780 Basic-Fit facilities.

charts.title: Share of people who are members of a gym in Europe in 2022, by country
charts.short: Health club penetration rate in Europe 2022, by country
charts.description: In 2022, around one fifth of the population of Norway were members of a gym or heath club. By contrast, the fitness club penetration rate in Italy was below 10 percent.

charts.title: Most popular sporting activities in France as of July 2023
charts.short: Leading sports activities in France 2023
charts.description: A July 2023 survey in France revealed running and hiking to be the most popular sporting activity in the country. Meanwhile, one fifth of respondents stated that they took part in water sports.
charts.note: France; July 2023; 4,258 respondents; 15 years and older

charts.title: Frequency of doing physical activity in France in 2023
charts.short: Frequency of exercise in France 2023
charts.description: A July 2023 survey in France revealed that over one quarter of respondents took part in physical activity four times or more per week. By contrast, just under 20 percent of respondents stated that they exercised less than once a week.
charts.note: France; July 2023; 4,258 respondents; 15 years and older

charts.title: Share of people who regularly take part in sport in France in 2023, by age group
charts.short: People practicing sports in France 2023, by age group
charts.description: A 2023 survey in France revealed that one fifth of respondents aged 15 to 24 did not take part in regular physical activity. Meanwhile, approximately 62 percent of respondents aged 70 or older stated that they regularly exercised.
charts.note: France; July 2023; 4,258 respondents; 15 years and older

charts.title: Most common reasons why people engage in physical activity and sports in France in 2023
charts.short: Leading reasons to engage in physical activity in France 2023
charts.description: A July 2023 survey in France explored the reasons why people took part in physical activity. During the survey, over half of respondents stated that they exercised for health reasons. Meanwhile, 10 percent of respondents took part in physical activity to meet other people.
charts.note: France; July 2023; 4,258 respondents; 15 years and older
charts.source: CRÉDOC; INJEP; Ministère de la Jeunesse et des Sports Share of respondents

charts.title: Most common locations to take participate in sporting activities in France in 2023
charts.short: Fitness participation in France in 2023, by location
charts.description: A July 2023 survey in France revealed the most common locations to take part in sporting activities. Over one third of respondents exercised outside in nature, while one quarter took part in activities at a sports facility.
charts.note: France; July 2023; 4,258 respondents; 15 years and older

charts.title: Most common reasons for exercising at home in France in 2023
charts.short: Reasons to exercise at home in France 2023
charts.description: A July 2023 survey in France revealed the main reasons why some fitness fans preferred exercising at home. Over 30 percent of respondents stated that they did sport at home because it allowed them to do it whenever they wanted, while just under 20 percent said that working out at home was less expensive.
charts.note: France; July 2023; 4,258 respondents; 15 years and older
categories: To do it when I want

charts.title: Fitness and health service purchases in France as of March 2024
charts.short: Fitness and health service purchases in France 2024
charts.description: 7 percent of French respondents answer our survey on "Fitness and health service purchases" with "Online services (website or apps)". The survey was conducted in 2024, among 2,034 consumers.
charts.note: France; April 2023 to March 2024; 2034 respondents; 18-64 years
charts.source: Statista Consumer Insights Share of respondents
categories: I haven't spent any money on fitness or health services

charts.title: Consumer Price Index (CPI) of sporting goods, camping and outdoor activities gear in France between May 2020 and January 2024
charts.short: CPI of sporting goods, camping and outdoor activities gear in France 2020-2024
charts.description: The consumer price index (CPI) is the instrument measuring inflation. It is used to estimate, between two given periods, the average variation in the prices of products consumed by households.This graph depicts the Consumer Price Index (CPI) of sporting goods, camping and outdoor activities gear in France between May 2020 and January 2024. In January 2024, the CPI reached 109.53.

charts.title: Revenue in the sports & swimwear for women segment of the apparel market France from 2018 to 2028 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Revenue in the sports & swimwear for women segment France 2018-2028
charts.description: The revenue in the 'Sports & Swimwear for women' segment of the apparel market in France was forecast to continuously increase between 2024 and 2028 by in total 0.2 billion U.S. dollars (+12.99 percent). After the sixth consecutive increasing year, the indicator is estimated to reach 1.74 billion U.S. dollars and therefore a new peak in 2028.

charts.title: Value of articles and equipment for physical exercise, gymnastics, athletics and other sports imported to France from 2015 to 2023 (in 1,000 euros)
charts.short: France: articles and equipment for sports import value 2015-2023
charts.description: In 2023, the value generated from the import of articles and equipment for physical exercise, gymnastics, athletics and other sports in France decreased by 284.5 million Euros (-17.37 percent) since 2022. Nevertheless, the last two years in this industry recorded a significant higher value than the preceding years.

charts.title: Sales revenue from nutritional supplements in direct and distance selling channels in France in 2022, by type of channel (in million euros)
charts.short: Turnover of food supplements in direct and distance selling in France 2022
charts.description: This bar chart displays the turnover of nutritional supplements in direct and distance selling channels in France in 2022, by type of selling. It shows that the sales of food supplements online amounted to 202 million euros in 2022.
charts.source: FEVAD; Sources diverses (Manufacturers and retailers); SYNADIET Sales value in million euros

charts.title: Breakdown of the sales value of the adult dietetics sector in France in 2022, by category
charts.short: Distribution of the sales value of the dietetics foods sector France 2022, by diet
charts.description: While the previous year gluten-free products made up almost half of the sales value of the adult dietetics foods sector, in 2022, slimming products took their place on the first step of the podium. Indeed, weight-loss food products accounted for 46.2 percent of the sales value of the adult dietetics sector, while gluten-free products took up over 33 percent.
charts.source: IRI; L’Alliance 7; Syndicat français de la nutrition spécialisée

charts.title: Revenue in the health & fitness segment of the app market France from 2017 to 2027 (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Revenue in the health & fitness segment of the app market France 2017-2027
charts.description: The indicator 'Revenue By Segment' in the 'Health & Fitness' segment of the app market in France was forecast to continuously increase between 2024 and 2027 by in total 38.9 million U.S. dollars (+38.22 percent). After the fifth consecutive increasing year, the indicator is estimated to reach 140.67 million U.S. dollars and therefore a new peak in 2027.

charts.title: Revenue in the Digital Fitness & Well-Being market for different segments France from 2018 to 2028 (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Revenue in the Digital Fitness & Well-Being market France 2018-2028
charts.description: Over the last two observations, the indicator 'Revenue by market' is forecast to significantly increase in all segments. As part of the positive trend, the indicator reaches the maximum value for all two different segments at the end of the comparison period. Particularly noteworthy is the segment Fitness Trackers, which has the highest value of 1.4 billion U.S. dollars.

charts.title: Number of users in the digital fitness & well-being devices segment of the digital health market France from 2018 to 2028 (in million individuals)
charts.short: Users in the digital fitness & well-being devices segment France 2018-2028
charts.description: The indicator 'Users by market' in the 'Fitness Trackers' segment of the digital health market in France was forecast to continuously increase between 2024 and 2028 by in total 0.3 million users (+3.79 percent). After the tenth consecutive increasing year, the indicator is estimated to reach 8.21 million users and therefore a new peak in 2028. Notably, the indicator 'Users by market' of the 'Fitness Trackers' segment of the digital health market was continuously increasing over the past years.

charts.title: Number of users in the digital fitness & well-being apps segment of the digital health market France from 2018 to 2028 (in million individuals)
charts.short: Users in the digital fitness & well-being apps segment France 2018-2028
charts.description: The indicator 'Users by market' in the 'Health & wellness coaching' segment of the digital health market in France was forecast to continuously increase between 2024 and 2028 by in total 4.8 million users (+16.83 percent). After the tenth consecutive increasing year, the indicator is estimated to reach 33.33 million users and therefore a new peak in 2028. charts.title: Share of respondents who use connected technology to track their physical activity in France as of July 2023
charts.short: Use of fitness tracking technology in France 2023
charts.description: A July 2023 survey in France explored exercise habits and the use of fitness technology. During the survey 35 percent of respondents stated that they used connected technology to track their activity levels.
charts.note: France; July 2023; 4,258 respondents; 15 years and older
